# Caelestinus Caelestinus Central was built forty years ago by a trade company, under TSF and USSP guns, as a harbour for the people pouring into Colossus. When the Federation tried to rule its trade, the company declared itself neutral. It has answered to no navy since.
During the reignited war, Federation contractors sent to secure the colonies watched how the TSFMC fought, laid down their contracts and came to Caelestinus. Some still call them ColSec. They became the station's guard, and since the Caelestinus Accord they are [textlink="the Bench" link="WFLoreJudges"].
Caelestinus is run in two halves: - [bold]The Bench[/bold]: the [bold]Overseer[/bold] and the [bold]judges[/bold]. They hold the anchors, the station and the [textlink="Common Writ" link="WFCommonWrit"]. - [bold]Medical Dispatch[/bold]: the [bold]Director of Care[/bold] and the [bold]Emergency Responders[/bold]. They answer for everyone, the Bench's prisoners included.
Caelestinus keeps three oaths and does not compromise on them: > Protect and aid the people of the Colossus sector. > Bring down any threat to their well-being. > Answer to no navy.
Caelestinus Central sits at the heart of the sector, in the middle of [textlink="the Lattice" link="WFLoreLattice"]. It is the one place in Colossus where the TSF and the Vanguard drink at the same bar, because the Writ forbids them anything else.
